name: KENT Crown Plus RO Water Purifier
summary: KENT Crown Plus-B uses an advanced RO + UV + UF + Copper + TDS Control purification process to remove dissolved impurities, bacteria, viruses, and harmful contaminants while retaining essential natural minerals through KENT's Mineral RO™ Technology .
intro: KENT Crown Plus-B is an advanced water purifier featuring RO + UV + UF + Copper + TDS Control technology to deliver 100% pure, safe, and healthy drinking water. It effectively removes bacteria, viruses, dissolved impurities, harmful chemicals, arsenic, pesticides, rust, and fluorides while retaining essential natural minerals for better taste and health. With a purification capacity of 20 litres per hour and a large 11-litre storage tank, it ensures an uninterrupted supply of purified water even during power cuts. The built-in Active Copper Technology enriches the purified water with copper, while the UV LED light continuously disinfects the stored water, preventing bacterial growth and maintaining freshness. Designed for brackish, tap, and municipal corporation water, KENT Crown Plus-B is built with durable ABS food-grade plastic and offers reliable performance backed by 1 year warranty and 3 years free service. Trusted by over 1 crore customers, KENT water purifiers are certified by BIS (ISI) and NSF, ensuring world-class quality and safety.
